actionableFindings.title: Deterministic script-transfer boundary is closed; actual FileRepresentation and transport integration remain unverified
actionableFindings.closedScope: Kyuva/Core/ScriptTextFile.swift:3-46 now centralizes the 1 MiB limit, UTF-8 decoding, and bounded safe export name. Tests/KyuvaTests/KyuvaCoreTests.swift:5-42 adds four boundary tests, and the fresh SwiftPM run passes 30/30. KyuvaMobile/Transfer/ScriptTextTransfer.swift:5-52 uses those helpers for FileRepresentation export and security-scoped import; project.pbxproj includes ScriptTextFile in both Mac and iOS source phases.
actionableFindings.residualScope: No deterministic test invokes ScriptTextTransfer.transferRepresentation's FileRepresentation closure or the actual ShareLink/fileImporter system UI. The simulator .txt round-trip is supporting evidence, not physical AirDrop/Files proof. The actual LocalRemoteServer/MacRemoteClient framing path is still not driven end-to-end; NWBrowser discovery and Local Network consent remain the separate F-002 gap.
actionableFindings.impact: The previous byte-boundary, UTF-8, and filename-sanitization test gap is closed. AC1 physical transfer and AC3 real transport integration cannot be marked PASS from these unit/build results alone.
actionableFindings.requiredResolution: Preserve F-003 as BLOCKED for the residual integration evidence; obtain the physical transfer/remote matrix for F-001 and, if deterministic coverage is required, add a harness for the FileRepresentation closure and real server/client framing without moving script content onto the remote channel.
